rules.title: San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance: criminal history in affordable housing decisions
rules.requirement: Housing providers making affordable housing decisions may not unfairly use an applicant's or resident's arrest or conviction history. The page gives only a one-line summary and does not describe the specific procedures or limits.
rules.coverage_conditions: Residents and applicants with arrest or conviction history, in affordable housing decisions in San Francisco.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: RESTRICTED: applies to affordable housing decisions only, per the page summary

rules.quoted_span: San Francisco's Fair Chance Ordinance protects residents with arrest or conviction history in affordable housing decisions.
rules.conflict_note: Source is an agency landing page with a one-line summary only. It gives no official code citation, effective date, or detailed requirements; verify against the ordinance text.
